proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201 first branch explicitly connects Nepali kamilo ant with dissimilated kipillaka/kiulī comparanda, preferring a *kãwilo history to karmin. Majhi/Bote kamila/kimila/komila preserve that ant family with vowels and endings qualified. Possible contamination with kīṭa/kṛmi and local transmission are not resolved. Exact response: kimila.
